tytul: Candied watermelon and melon rind: why there is no recipe here
wstep: There is no recipe here for candied watermelon rind or candied melon rind. [T:-]

ostrzezenia.tekst: According to an FDA table of approximate values, watermelon has a pH of 5.2–5.8. [T:SLO-024]
According to the same FDA table, cantaloupe melon has a pH of 6.17–7.13. [T:SLO-025]

According to a University of Missouri Extension newsletter, candied fruit retains a bit of moisture, so it is kept in an airtight container in the refrigerator to prevent mold and used within a week. [T:SLO-069]

akapity: JarAtlas has found no checked source for the pH of the rind of either fruit. [T:-]
JarAtlas has found no checked source for candied melon rind, and no tested process for rind kept in syrup. [T:-]
JarAtlas has found no checked source that says how long candied watermelon rind keeps. [T:-]
